reasons: Freight class on invoice (85) does not match BOL class (70) and no certified weight/class adjustment provided (Art. 9(c)).
Linehaul amount $814.02 exceeds contract‑computed net linehaul $710.65 after discount.
Fuel surcharge applied to inflated net linehaul; correct surcharge $177.30 vs invoiced $203.18.
Total due $1,017.20 is more than 1% above the contract‑supported amount ($887.95).
decision.dispute_summary: Invoice uses freight class 85 instead of BOL class 70 without a reweigh certificate, resulting in an inflated linehaul charge. Calculated contract‑allowed total is $887.95; invoice total is $1,017.20, overcharge $129.25.
